EpochLens

First-look figures for labeled EEG epochs.

This report is a first look at epoched EEG: waveforms, time–frequency, scalp, and covariance geometry. It is not a classifier, and it is not a preprocessing pipeline. Cross-validated LDA on pyRiemann log-Euclidean tangent space is a sanity check against chance, not a brain–computer interface.

2 s epochs · 16 channels · 96 trials · 256 Hz · 10 Hz × 24, 12 Hz × 24, 14 Hz × 24, 16 Hz × 24 · 512 samples · 0 – 1.99609 s · 3 sessions · montage · analysis window 0.6–1.4 s

Waveforms, CWT, and spectra use the top-k visualization subset. MDS and the chance check use the full montage (all channels).

Channels are sorted by that discriminability score. Dead, single-trial-dominated, or MAD-outlier sensors (log RMS) are excluded. Waveforms / CWT / spectra use the top-k subset; MDS and the chance check do not. The explorer table lists score, rank, visualization-subset membership, and session votes when available.
